terms: ## Conversational Texture The operator first saw the ledger seam produce real data directly, then explicitly asked to also run the genuine dispatch_auto scheduler to see the same capture happen through the full unattended path.

## Key Insights dispatch_auto requires a storyId plus a policy that authorizes real claude-code subprocess launch (allowRealHostSubprocess, the canonical claude --print launcher in commandAllowlist, requireReceipt/requireReview true, allowAutoMerge/allowProductionDone false). The worker runs claude --print --output-format json which surfaces the four-field Anthropic usage object the ledger records.

## Solution Tradeoffs No real development is intended; the worker objective is a trivial no-op reply so the dispatch completes quickly and cheaply while still exercising the real scheduler, real subprocess, and the usage-ledger write path. The story will be discarded after the probe.
